events.headline: Federal Reserve raises target federal funds rate 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, its first hike since 2023, citing inflation (~3.4% YoY) kept elevated partly by Middle East-driven energy price shocks; officials signal further hikes possible
EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook: Brent crude averaged $91/bbl in August, up $7 from July, as Middle East export constraints and regional oil-production shut-ins tighten global supply

Huawei unveils accelerated Ascend AI chip roadmap at Huawei Connect 2026, pulling the Ascend 960DT training chip forward three quarters to Q1 2027 and citing AI chip demand that outstrips its own capacity

US federal judge declines to break up Google's ad-tech business, instead ordering behavioral remedies (auction and interoperability changes, compliance monitor) for six years, removing a major structural-breakup overhang on Alphabet

China's suspension of tightened rare-earth, lithium-battery and superhard-material export controls (agreed after the Xi-Trump meeting) remains in force through November 10, 2026, easing near-term critical-minerals supply risk
European governments continue accelerating defense-industrial integration and joint manufacturing capacity amid persistent Russia-Ukraine and Middle East conflict risk
